result.title: Pregnancy steps for parents
plan: Notify employer of pregnancy leave: At least two months before it begins [2][3][4]
Apply for maternity grant from Kela: At least two months before the child’s due date [5][7]
Apply for pregnancy allowance from Kela: No later than two months after your leave starts [8][10]

evidence.title: InfoFinland - Pregnancy and childbirth
evidence.quote: When you realise that you are pregnant, contact the maternity clinic (äitiysneuvola) or family centre (perhekeskus) in your area.

evidence.title: InfoFinland - Support during pregnancy
evidence.quote: Remember to notify your employer about your pregnancy leave at least two (2) months before it begins.

evidence.title: During pregnancy | Our Services | Kela
evidence.quote: If you are working, you must inform your employer of your pregnancy leave no later than two months before the start of your leave.

evidence.title: InfoFinland - Pregnancy and childbirth
evidence.quote: If you have a job, give your employer written notification at least two months before you begin your pregnancy leave.

evidence.title: Maternity package or cash benefit | Our Services | Kela
evidence.quote: You should apply for the maternity grant no later than two months before the expected date of birth of the child.

evidence.title: Maternity package or cash benefit | Our Services | Kela
evidence.quote: The maternity grant as a cash benefit amounts to EUR 210

evidence.title: InfoFinland - Support during pregnancy
evidence.quote: Apply for maternity grant from Kela at least two months before the due date.

evidence.title: suomi.fi
evidence.quote: You must apply for your pregnancy allowance within two months of the start of your pregnancy leave at the latest.

evidence.title: suomi.fi
evidence.quote: The length of the pregnancy leave is 40 working days.

evidence.title: During pregnancy | Our Services | Kela
evidence.quote: Apply for the allowance within 2 months of the start of your pregnancy leave at the latest.

evidence.title: During pregnancy | Our Services | Kela
evidence.quote: Kela pays pregnancy allowance for a total of 40 days (Monday to Saturday, excluding mid-week holidays).
